exercises: an operation parameter overriding a path item parameter by matching name and in, and a same-name parameter in a different location that must not override
note: The override rule keys on the pair (name, in), not on name alone. The delete operation is here to catch an implementation that matches on name only: it would wrongly drop the path item's query `lang` and leave closeBranch with two parameters instead of three.
